info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Estimates-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates API provides access to estimated billing amounts for utility services based on user-specific consumption data. This endpoint allows users to retrieve projections of their utility costs, helping them plan and manage their expenses effectively. Typically utilized by customers, financial analysts, and service administrators, the API supports scenarios such as budget planning and billing inquiries. By accessing these estimates, consumers can make informed decisions regarding their utility usage and financial planning.

get.description: Fetches a detailed billing estimate based on the provided criteria. This operation allows users to understand potential charges before actual billing occurs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to estimate billing details based on the provided parameters. Please ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema to obtain accurate estimates.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.title: Billing Estimate Request Body
ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: The request body for the billing estimate operation. It is represented as a string.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.title: Billing Estimate Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the billing estimate.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the billing estimate.

state.description: The current state of the billing estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the billing estimate in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or messages related to the billing estimate operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the billing estimate.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.description: Response schema for a successful billing estimate retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The name or identifier of the user who created the billing estimate.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the billing estimate was created.
